data.one_liner: Converts currency codes to their corresponding currency symbols in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions and widgets to map currency codes like USD and EUR to their symbols such as $ and €. It supports over 100 currencies and includes enums for type-safe handling.
use_when: You need to display currency symbols based on standard currency codes in your UI
You want type-safe currency handling using provided enums
avoid_when: You need full internationalized currency formatting including locale-specific number formatting
You require currency conversion rates or financial transaction features
strengths: Includes both a utility function returning a string and a customizable widget
Supports type-safe currency code handling using enums
weaknesses: Does not handle full locale-aware currency and number formatting
Limited feature set beyond basic code-to-symbol mapping
